## 本紀錄的狀態與用途

本檔記錄 v0.1.0 的發行文件準備範圍與驗收要求。準備時尚未建立本版 tag 或 Release；本檔存在、版本條目提交或 PR 合併，都不證明已正式發行。它在後續發布後仍保留這個點時角色，不為反映成功而改寫歷史。

正式 publication truth 由 [Core repository](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core) 的 `v0.1.0` annotated tag object、解析後的完整 commit，以及 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/releases) 中相同 tag 的正式 metadata 共同確認。須讀回實際 tag、target、body、發布 URL，並確認 `draft=false`、`prerelease=false`；未知或矛盾不稱完成。這些連結是查核入口，不是已發布斷言。

## 範圍、來源與變更

本版是純 Markdown 共用工程契約的首版版本化包。既有四份 contracts 涵蓋 workflow、授權／停止、獨立 review／必要安全檢查，以及 exact-head／證據。先前新增的簡明寫作、證據生命週期、風險時機、安全政策／缺能力、前提與方案取捨義務保留，不改稱 runtime 新功能。

本次發行文件包只更新 `README.md`、`docs/provenance/source-map.md`，新增 `CHANGELOG.md` 與本檔。其他九個既有檔案保持 bytes／mode，尤其不改四份正式 contracts。原 107 單位、來源 hash、notices 與過往不發行工作包歷史保留。新批准只授權此 Core 發行包的 tag／Release，不倒寫舊授權。

準備基線為 `64b19bb5658432c42cd6a26aa357fd6b1d0fd857`。它只用於差異與歷史對照，不能當成本次最終發行 pin。發行必須指向包含本次文件、經完整審查及合併的最終 commit。P1 抽取來源仍固定於 `codex-dev-skills@993597561881d6ed8c552f9a18c59315015ad245`；官方能力比較仍為 2026-10-14 的文件研究，不重跑平台資格。

## 版本、相依與消費者影響

Core 文件版本與 `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` 的命名及 `0.x` 變更界線見 [CHANGELOG](../../CHANGELOG.md#changelog-zh-tw)。版本由 Markdown 記錄，不新增 catalog、VERSION、JSON／schema、installer、validator 或執行套件。Core 版本獨立於各 consumer；沒有 lockstep 升版、模型相容或兩端行為等價保證。

使用者不需獨立安裝 Core。各接口負責實際技能、工具／模型／effort／session、驗證器、安裝及組裝。Consumer 採用時須核對 annotated tag，解析並固定完整最終 commit，重算所選文件逐檔與集合 digest，審查 allowlist、相對連結的完整 dependency closure、來源與 notices。Runtime 使用已組裝固定文件，不追蹤 Core `main` 或動態 tag。

新增兩份文件會使完整清冊由 11 檔變成預期 13 檔，Markdown 由 10 份變成 12 份。Consumer 應個別判斷需納入哪些文件及引用，更新 lock／snapshot／組裝與自己的遵循驗證；不能把舊基線或舊 10 份 Markdown digest 當作本版完整身分。Core 發行不自動更新任何 consumer 或已安裝技能。

## 預期清冊與完整性

| 範圍 | 路徑 |
| --- | --- |
| 入口與版本歷史 | `README.md`、`CHANGELOG.md` |
| 正式契約 | `contracts/workflow.md`、`contracts/authorization-and-stops.md`、`contracts/review-and-security.md`、`contracts/exact-head-and-evidence.md` |
| 架構歷史 | `docs/architecture/project-split.md`、`docs/architecture/dependency-inventory.md`、`docs/architecture/migration-plan.md` |
| 來源及 notices | `docs/provenance/source-map.md`、`docs/provenance/upstream-notices.md` |
| 發行準備與授權 | `docs/releases/v0.1.0.md`、`LICENSE` |

最終 manifest 以受審合併內容為準；每檔記 raw SHA-256、bytes 與 Git mode。全 repository 集合包含 LICENSE；完整 Markdown 集合只含 `.md`。兩種 digest 分列，不把 consumer 所選子集冒稱完整集合。算法為 `sha256-path-tab-sha256-lf-v1`：依 UTF-8 path bytes 排序，串接 `path<TAB>raw-file-sha256<LF>`，再做 SHA-256；size／mode 另記。Source archives 的壓縮容器 digest 與 raw 文件集合 digest 不同。

本檔不內嵌自身最終 commit 或 digest，以免自引用。合併後的 tag annotation、Release metadata 及交接證據承載完整不可變 pin 與最終 manifest；只使用 GitHub 自帶 source archives 及 Markdown 說明，不新增 installer 或二進位資產。

## 必要驗收與限制

- 修改前核對正常發布能力、真實 Issue／DoD、遠端 Issue-ID 分支及其追蹤 checkout；來源 ownership 與授權須成立。能力缺口不授權升權、改 credentials／App／全域設定或改用私有介面；停止相依發布，保留無相依文件準備。
- 核對四檔實際差異、純 Markdown＋LICENSE、13 檔清冊、九檔保護、原 107 單位／歷史／notices、兩語主要資訊等價，以及 links／anchors／LF／whitespace。以可用本地 renderer 查呈現並記範圍；不將本地結果冒稱 GitHub 完整 render，不額外向外部呈現服務 POST 文件。
- 依實際 trust／install／supply-chain 影響評估必要安全分析與比例 scan。Markdown 不構成 blanket exemption；不適用須記 scope 及理由，必要但未執行不記 Passed。舊工作包 verdict 不替代本候選證據。
- 必要 gate 通過後才 commit／push／draft PR。對當前完整 base-to-head 重新獨立 Merge Review／coherence，核對適用 CI／provider／gates，Ready 後以 expected-head 一般合併並保留分支。新 head 須重新完整審查。CI 未配置或未執行各自如實記錄，不新增 CI 框架或假記成功。
- 發布前預覽確切 repository、tagger、新 annotated tag、最終 commit、正式 Release 兩語 body 及 manifest；重查版本未占用，不 force 或覆寫。各次 mutation 後讀回實際身分與結果，未知結果不盲重播，缺必要讀回不稱完成。

本紀錄不宣稱上述待執行步驟已通過；實際命令、結果、findings／dispositions 與 gates 保存在當次證據。未驗證 consumer 遵循、模型／runtime、Grok Build、live／公司案例、成本或延遲；不宣稱全面無漏洞或完整 ASD-STE100 符合性。不安裝、部署、改 consumer／vendor／pin 或既有技能，不啟用 memory/hooks/schedulers，不操作公司系統、EdgeInstaller、Orca 或其他專案。Space 同步由指定協調者處理，與本 Core 發行證據分開。

## License 與追溯

本 repository 使用 [MIT LICENSE](../../LICENSE)，並保留 [完整上游 notices](../provenance/upstream-notices.md)。分發 substantial portions 時須保留完整 copyright／permission／warranty notices、固定來源與修改標記，不以 URL 或目的 LICENSE 取代。[來源對照](../provenance/source-map.md) 區分原抽取與後續要求；[CHANGELOG](../../CHANGELOG.md) 保留版本及影響摘要。繁體中文仍是正式契約權威；英文提供等價導讀，不新增義務，未完成全部 ASD-STE100 規則及詞彙驗證。

## Status and purpose of this record

This file records the scope and acceptance requirements for v0.1.0 release documents. At preparation time, this version has no tag or Release. The file, a committed version entry, or a merged PR does not prove publication. This remains a point-in-time record after publication. Do not rewrite its history merely to show success.

Publication truth requires the `v0.1.0` annotated tag object and its full resolved commit in the [Core repository](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core), together with the formal metadata for the same tag in [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/releases). Read back the actual tag, target, body, and publication URL. Confirm `draft=false` and `prerelease=false`. An unknown or conflicting result is incomplete. These links are verification entrypoints, not claims of publication.

## Scope, sources, and changes

This is the first versioned package of the shared Markdown engineering contracts. Four existing contracts cover workflow, authority and stopping, independent review and required security checks, and exact-head and evidence. Retain the earlier obligations for plain writing, evidence lifecycle, risk timing, security policy and missing capabilities, assumptions, and options. These are not new runtime features.

This release-document packet updates only `README.md` and `docs/provenance/source-map.md`. It adds `CHANGELOG.md` and this file. The other nine existing files keep their bytes and modes, including all four formal contracts. Retain the original 107 units, source hashes, notices, and earlier packets' no-release history. New approval covers tag and Release publication for this Core packet only. It does not rewrite earlier authority.

The preparation base is `64b19bb5658432c42cd6a26aa357fd6b1d0fd857`. It identifies the comparison and history. It is not this release's final pin. Publication must target the final reviewed merge commit that includes these documents. P1's extraction source remains `codex-dev-skills@993597561881d6ed8c552f9a18c59315015ad245`. The official capability comparison remains document research from 2026-10-14. Do not rerun platform qualification.

## Versions, dependencies, and consumer impact

See [CHANGELOG](../../CHANGELOG.md#changelog-en) for the Core document version, `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` names, and `0.x` change limits. Markdown records the version. Add no catalog, VERSION, JSON/schema, installer, validator, or executable package. Core and consumers have separate versions. Matching version numbers, model compatibility, and equivalent behavior are not guaranteed.

Users do not install Core separately. Each interface owns actual skills, tools, model/effort/session controls, validators, installation, and assembly. For adoption, verify the annotated tag and lock its full final commit. Recompute per-file and set digests for the selected documents. Review the allowlist, complete dependency closure of relative references, sources, and notices. Runtime uses assembled fixed documents. It must not follow Core `main` or a dynamic tag.

Two new documents change the expected full inventory from 11 to 13 files, and Markdown from 10 to 12 files. Each consumer assesses which files and references it needs, then updates its lock, snapshot, assembly, and conformance checks. Do not use the old base or old 10-file Markdown digest as this version's full identity. Core publication does not update consumers or installed skills automatically.

## Expected inventory and integrity

| Scope | Paths |
| --- | --- |
| Entry and version history | `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` |
| Formal contracts | `contracts/workflow.md`, `contracts/authorization-and-stops.md`, `contracts/review-and-security.md`, `contracts/exact-head-and-evidence.md` |
| Architecture history | `docs/architecture/project-split.md`, `docs/architecture/dependency-inventory.md`, `docs/architecture/migration-plan.md` |

| Preparation and license | `docs/releases/v0.1.0.md`, `LICENSE` |

The reviewed merge determines the final manifest. Record each file's raw SHA-256, bytes, and Git mode. The full repository set includes LICENSE. The complete Markdown set contains only `.md` files. List both digests separately. A consumer's selected subset is not the complete set. Use `sha256-path-tab-sha256-lf-v1`: sort by UTF-8 path bytes, concatenate `path<TAB>raw-file-sha256<LF>`, then calculate SHA-256. Record size and mode separately. A source archive container digest differs from the raw document-set digest.

Do not embed this file's own final commit or digest. After merge, the tag annotation, Release metadata, and handoff evidence contain the full immutable pin and final manifest. Use only GitHub's built-in source archives and Markdown descriptions. Add no installer or binary assets.

## Required acceptance and limits

- Before tracked edits, verify the normal publication channel, a real Issue and DoD, the remote Issue-ID branch, and its tracking checkout. Confirm writer ownership and authority. A capability gap does not permit escalation, credentials/App/global-setting changes, or private interfaces. Stop dependent publication while retaining independent document preparation.
- Check the actual four-file diff, Markdown plus LICENSE, 13-file inventory, nine protected files, original 107 units, history and notices, equivalent main information in both languages, links, anchors, LF, and whitespace. Use an available local renderer and state its limits. Do not claim full GitHub rendering or POST documents to an extra external rendering service.
- Assess required security analysis and proportionate scans from actual trust, installation, and supply-chain impact. Markdown is not a blanket exemption. An inapplicable check needs a scope and reason. A required unexecuted check is not Passed. Earlier packet verdicts do not replace evidence for this candidate.
- Commit, push, and create a draft PR only after required gates pass. Perform a new independent complete base-to-head Merge Review and coherence check at the current head. Check applicable CI, provider enforcement, and gates. Mark Ready, then use an expected-head normal merge and retain the branch. A new head needs a new complete review. Report unconfigured and unexecuted CI accurately. Add no CI framework or invented success.
- Before publication, preview the exact repository, tagger, new annotated tag, final commit, bilingual formal Release body, and manifest. Recheck that the version is unused. Do not force or overwrite. Read back each mutation's actual identity and result. Do not blindly replay an unknown result or claim completion without required readback.

This record does not claim those pending steps passed. Keep actual commands, results, findings, dispositions, and gates in the current evidence. Consumer conformance, model/runtime behavior, Grok Build, live/company cases, cost, and latency are unverified. Make no claim of complete vulnerability absence or full ASD-STE100 conformance. Do not install, deploy, change consumers/vendor/pins/existing skills, enable memory/hooks/schedulers, or operate company systems, EdgeInstaller, Orca, or other projects. The designated coordinator handles Space synchronization separately from Core publication evidence.
